message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Customer Concentration Ratio", "construction": "Sum the percentage of total revenue derived from the firm's top 3 customers, as disclosed in annual filings.", "rationale": "Greater dependence on a few customers increases business risk and may not be fully priced.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Expense Deferral Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of capitalized expenses (e.g., capitalized R&D, software development costs) to total expenses in the most recent fiscal year.", "rationale": "Firms deferring more expenses may be engaging in earnings management, which could signal future risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Insider Loan Guarantee Exposure", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if insiders have guaranteed company debt (disclosed in proxy or 10-K), 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Insider financial commitment may signal alignment of interests and unpriced risk.", "higher_returns_for": "value of 1 (insiders guaranteeing company debt)"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Volatility", "construction": "Compute standard deviation of quarterly changes in current assets over the past 12 quarters, scaled by average current assets.", "rationale": "Higher volatility in short-term assets may indicate operational uncertainty and mispricing.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Supplier Payment Stretch", "construction": "Change in days payable outstanding (DPO) over the past year.", "rationale": "Firms stretching payables may be facing financial constraints, which could foreshadow distress risk premium.", "higher_returns_for": "high increases in DPO"}, {"name": "Cost of Goods Sold Smoothing", "construction": "Calculate the autocorrelation of quarterly cost of goods sold (COGS) over the past 12 quarters.", "rationale": "Higher autocorrelation may reflect earnings management or operational rigidity, both potentially underpriced.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Citation Growth", "construction": "Annual growth rate in the number of patent citations disclosed in patent filings or annual reports.", "rationale": "Rising patent citations may capture future innovation unrecognized by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Contingent Liability Density", "construction": "Sum of estimated contingent liabilities (e.g., pending litigation, environmental fines) as a percentage of total assets, as disclosed in notes to financial statements.", "rationale": "Firms with higher contingent liabilities may face unpriced risks that could result in higher required returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Depreciation Ratio", "construction": "Ratio of accumulated amortization of capitalized R&D to total capitalized R&D on the balance sheet.", "rationale": "Higher ratios might signal mature or declining innovation assets, hence higher risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Non-GAAP Earnings Prevalence", "construction": "Count of non-GAAP earnings adjustments reported in press releases over the trailing year.", "rationale": "Frequent adjustments may indicate earnings quality concerns and hence higher risk premia.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
